open_items: Complete profile/CLI composition and persistent checkpoint/work adapters in their scheduled steps.
These counters do not measure CPU instructions, wall time, host memory or authenticate external quota data.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die SRX-Konfiguration MUSS AST-Knoten und Strukturtiefe als explizite Strukturgrenzen sowie Iterations-, Graph- und Auswertungsschrittzahlen als weiche fortsetzbare Arbeitsziele nach Anhang O.1 unterscheiden.
oracle.scope: Explicit AST node/depth limits and deterministic work counters. Soft overrun continues in-process without fabricated checkpoint, truncated value or rule failure.

preconditions: Explicit SRX 1.0 program and immutable four-root context; versioned AST and work policy.
steps: Validate full executable AST against positive node/depth limits before evaluation.
Evaluate to completion beyond soft expression/quantifier/graph targets and inspect owned work observations.
Observe first soft overruns without hiding later actual errors; reject inactive forbidden expressions and foreign conversion hooks before execution.
